decisions.reason: The biodynamic natural yogurt range is close to the firm's established organic dairy offer and is a flagship product, so related knowledge and in-house R&D support learning and improvement.
Mild sliced cheese builds directly on the firm's existing cheese-making knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and refine the product.
Sliced butter cheese is close to the firm's established dairy and cheese capabilities, and its own R&D provides absorptive capacity to improve the product.
